intervals.note: 1990 is the year the DAMA project was first funded by INFN; the collaboration's own founding date is not published. The collaboration is recorded as active because the LNGS page lists other DAMA set-ups (DAMA/LXe, DAMA/Ge) as in operation, although DAMA/LIBRA's data taking is reported to have ended in 2024.

summary.plain: The Italian-Chinese team that runs the DAMA experiments at the Gran Sasso laboratory in Italy. Their sodium-iodide detectors, DAMA/NaI and DAMA/LIBRA, reported a yearly rise and fall in their signal that the team interprets as dark matter. The result has not been confirmed by other experiments.
summary.technical: DAMA ('an observatory for rare processes') project at LNGS: Roma Tor Vergata, Roma La Sapienza and INFN groups, with IHEP Beijing; spokesperson Rita Bernabei (LNGS page). Set-ups: DAMA/NaI (about 100 kg NaI(Tl)), DAMA/LIBRA (about 250 kg NaI(Tl)), DAMA/LXe, DAMA/R&D, DAMA/Ge, DAMA/CRYS.
